tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i dpal rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rta mgrin nag po bsgrub par 'dod pas/ dang po stan bde bar 'dug nas skyabs 'gro lan gsum byas te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rta mgrin bsgom snyam du sems bskyed/ rang nyid rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin gyi dbu'i cha la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na mo badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ zhes brjod/ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ yan lag bdun pa lan gsum bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar nag /de las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog /de rnams rta mgrin gyi skur gyur/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri bskal pa'i me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa na nad gdon sreg par byed pa'i me'i phung po rab tu 'bar ba bsnams pa/

spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal gyi mche ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yas su gtsigs shing*/ g.yon du rngam pa/ sma ra dang dbu skra gyen du 'bar zhing 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ spyi bo nas rta mgo ljang zhur 'thon pa'i rta skad kyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ klu rgyal rigs dkar pos dbu brgyan cing*/ bram ze'i rigs ser pos mgul rgyan/ rje'u rigs ser pos phyag gdub/ gdol rigs nag pos ga sha /dmangs rigs ser khras zhabs gdub byas pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal sogs dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ khro gnyer shin tu bsdus shing rab tu 'jigs par byed pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sku lus sbom la thung ba/ ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du hrīḥdamar nag tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs la/ mchod bstod bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs mchod pas mchod/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur pas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ hūm̐/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku/ sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥdamar po'i tha mar rtsa sngags kyis g.yon skor du bskor te gnas pa las/ rtsa sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pa zhal nas thon/ phrin las bsgrubs/ tshur 'dus thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim par bsam zhing sngags bzlas par bya'o// hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba sarba tsitta kā la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha rbad rbud gtubs/ shag ha nan rbad rbud gtubs/ gṛhṇa rā dza ya rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa ci nus bzlas so// de nas mchod bstod byas te spyod lam la 'jug go /bsnyen tshad ni 'bum phrag gcig gam bzhi'am brgyad la sogs pa bzlas par bya'o// de nas thun mtshams su gtor ma gtang bar 'dod na gtor ma sha khrag la sogs pas brgyan par byas la/

a mṛtas bgegs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas thod pa'i nang du dam rdzas phun sum tshogs pas gang bar bsam la yi ge gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas maṇḍal gyi steng ngam/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mgron spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐/ gnyis med rang byung dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// brjod med chos nyid don las ma g.yos kyang*// dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i don slad du// brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'jig rten rnal 'byor dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// nyi zla padma brtsegs pa'i gdan steng gi/ ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rngam brjid ngar dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya st+waṃ/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku /sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes brjod de byon par bsam/ de nas zhabs bsil/ mchod yon phul nas/ ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā tsitta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/

mchod pa lngas mchod la/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid// chos nyid mi 'gyur rta mchog rol pa'i sku /gsung chen rta skad 'tsher bas gdug pa 'dul// dbyer med lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'gyur med rtogs pas sku mdog nag /shes rab ral gri 'phyar bas 'khor ba gcod// g.yon na me dpung bsnams pas bdud rnams sreg /'jigs byed drag po khyod= khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// srid gsum sreg mdzad spyan gsum me dpung 'phro// smin ma glog stong ma rig mun pa 'joms// gshin rje khros pa'i sku la= zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rab tu gtsigs// rnam thar brgyad ldan dpal gyi chas brgyad gsol// zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad pas bdud rnams 'joms// dbang chen khros pa'i sku la= mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la= 'gag med padma'i gsung la= dbyer med brtse ba'i thugs la= dam rdzas 'bar ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab// dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o// badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu ste gtor ma'i rim pa'o/ ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i las tshogs la lnga ste/ dang po nad pa gso ba ni/ rang rta mgrin ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas par bsgom/

sa bdag klu gnyan rnams bskal pa'i me la sbrang bu mi gnas pa bzhin du thul thul bsregs par bsam la rtsa sngags kyi gsham du/ sarba nā ga tsitta breng shag mā ra ya thum rbad/ ces pa btags la brgya bzlas so// gnyis pa steng gdon gzir ba ni/ rang rta mgrin du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas gdon gyi snying dkar nag gi mtshams nas bzung la sngags 'dis gzir te/ e hur thuṃ dza/
'phrog byed 'bru bzhi/
trig nan māraya rbad/
gzir byed 'bru bzhi/
gnod byed sarba
ma mo thams cad 'dus pa'i snying po/
tsitta gtubs/
gsod byed 'bru bzhi/
srog gzer rbud nan/ tri phu hri shag rbad rbad/
dpe dag pa gcig la

ces snang mchan/
ces pa rtsa sngags la btags te bzlas so// gsum pa lus bsrung ba ni/ sarba nā ga ha la ha la/ tsi ma tri phyung tri shag mā ra ya rbad/
dpe gcig la sa ha ga ha la ha la tsa ma ri phyung*/ hrīḥshag mā ra ya rbad/ ces snang ngo*//

ces pa rang gi dri chu la mang du bzlas te/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam ste 'thungs pas rtsa dang rtsa phran thams cad du song bas nad gdon thams cad nyi mas mun pa sel ba bzhin sngon dmar du byas nas 'thon par bsam/ de nas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad hūm̐ gis gtam par bsam mo// bzhi pa ser ba bsrung ba ni/ ser ba'i snying po dzwa la raṃ rbad zlog bhyoḥ zhes pa rtsa sngags kyi sham bur btags la/ yungs dkar rgyal po dang*/ thal chen la mang du bzlas la g.yas pa'i ral gri me 'bar bas sprin gshags par bsam/ g.yon gyi mes bsregs par bsam/ de nas thun 'phang bas bcad par bsam mo// lnga pa phyir bzlog pa ni/ dmar gtor gcig bshams nas de dgra bo'i sha khrag tu bsam la rta mgrin gyi zhal du bstab bo// de nas/ rbad ta ya rbad ta ya lo ka rbad ta ya phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha/ zlog zlog /ces pa rtsa sngags la btags pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ thebs ldog brtsis la zor du 'phang ngo*// byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa rdzogs so/ ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ gnas dben par maṇḍal khru gang pa la/ ba byung lngas byugs pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i dbus su rta mgrin gyi sku dang sgrub pa'i chos dang seng ldeng gi phur pa ste/

de ltar sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mthar mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gcig bsham mo// de nas slob dpon khrus byas te/ mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgoms la bzlas pa cung zad byas te/ maṇḍal gyi tshom bu'i steng du yang rta mgrin bskyed chog byas la mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul lo// de nas slob ma khrus byas te phyag 'tshal te/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ khyed rnams dpal rta mgrin gyi dbang zhu ba de tshe 'di'i nad zhi ba dang*/ gdon zhi ba dang*/ phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba ni ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rta mgrin gyi rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu snyam pa mdzod la maṇḍal zhig phul mdzod byas la tshar ba dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la dbang bskur bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba btab/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bzhugs pa'i spyan snga nas yar la yan lag bdun pa phul bar bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad par zhu/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar lan gsum brjod du gzhug /de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dpal rta mgrin bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ji srid dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ khro bo'i rgyal po yi dam du bzung bar 'tshal gyis/ slob dpon gyis dpal rta mgrin bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa ni sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas kyi sdig sgrib bag chags snang ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus mthing nag /de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/

oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor me tog re bzhag la/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar nag de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dpal rta mgrin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhes pa nas/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa la cung zad cig mchod la/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// dpal rta mgrin 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'di la dbang skur cig /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// rta mgrin go 'phang ma 'thob bar// yi dam lha ru mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ rta mgrin khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas mar la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyi ye shes pa bstim pa bya ba yin/ de ltar thim pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can sku mdog nag po/ ces pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed la/ de'i spyi bor bris sku bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dbang*// gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni// bdud dang nyon mongs 'joms par mdzad// de ring khyed la sbyin par bya// rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/

kā ya ā bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol/ yang pusti spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi dbang*// gang gis bklags pa tsam gyis ni// dngos grub rnam gnyis thob 'gyur ba// de ring khyed la sbyin par bya// rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas lung gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rta mgrin du gsal ba'i snying ga'i dkyil du yi ge hrīḥdamar nag cig sgoms mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ maṇḍal gyi steng gi rta mgrin la phog pas de'i thugs rgyud bskul/ rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin thol thol byung*/ rta mgrin gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang der bsgoms pa'i zhal du zhugs/ hrīḥdamar nag gi mtha' skor du 'khod par mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug /de nas slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis// zhes pa nas/

sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar brjod la me tog gtor ba ni bzlas pa'i lung ngo*// de rjes ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi dbang*/ gang gis bcangs pa tsam gyis ni// bdud dang log lta 'joms par byed// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// rtsa sngags/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas seng ldeng gi phur pa bsgril zhing gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las dbang*// gang gis bsgril ba tsam gyis ni// bdud dang log lta gsod par byed// de ring khyod la= rtsa sngags dang*/ karma kī li kī la ya/ sarba bighnān a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod de/ sku gsung thugs dang phrin las kyi dbang ngo*// 1$0000250de nas gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/1$0000300 paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du gtor ma 'di ni tha mal pa'i gtor ma ma yin par yi ge hrīḥdamar nag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gtor ma de nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog nag po 1$0000250ces pa nas/1$0000300 thugs ka'i stod du hrīḥdamar nag tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ 1$0000250ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed la/1$0000300 thugs ka'i hrīḥdang slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas po ta la nas/ dpal rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

bar gyis/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la dbang skur du gsol/ 'di rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'di rnams kyi nad dang gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dbang phyug la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzhan yang las ngan sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma 'thob kyi bar du dpal rta mgrin rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod// 1$0000250ces pas phrin las bcol/1$0000300 slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇḍal 'bul/ deng nas sogs brjod/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ tsaka li la brtan bzhugs bya/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ smon lam ci shes gang rigs btab la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
